description: Searches the Piko marketplace in one country, by meaning and by exact words. Returns at most 5 providers or 10 listings from real accounts, ordered by relevance, each with its pikosabe.com link. Listings that are job openings or job seekers' offers carry a job field with the working arrangement and the pay when stated. A count of 0 means no listing matches these terms; when the whole market has no listing yet, the result carries a market field that says so and names the markets that have listings. Results carry no phone number: contact happens on the pikosabe.com page of the listing or profile.

city.description: Limits the search to this city, for example "Asunción".

country.description: Market to read, as the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country: 244 markets are open, among them PY = Paraguay, BO = Bolivia. Results stay within that market.

job_openings.description: true: only job openings, the positions an employer wants to fill (a nanny, a shop assistant). They are demand listings of type service; mode, side and types are set accordingly.

job_seekers.description: true: only job seekers, the providers who marked a service offer as available for a job, with the arrangement and the pay they expect when stated. They are offer listings of type service; mode, side and types are set accordingly. Not combined with job_openings.

mode.description: providers: people who offer a service, grouped by profile. listings: individual published offers or demands of any type.

neighborhood.description: Limits the search to this neighborhood of the city.

query.description: What is searched: a short phrase such as "plomero", "auto usado" or "Toyota Hilux". Listings are written in the language of their market, so a phrase in that language matches best.

side.description: Listings mode only. offer: things and services people offer. demand: things and services people are looking for. Omitted: both.

types.description: Listings mode only. Limits the search to these listing types.

name: search
title: Search Piko
